*.why: Core assigns ids and times. Ids made during a case (<id:n> here) are compared by shape: the recorded prefix (conn-, project-, label-, saved-, ver-) and a v4 uuid, bound to the Core id the first time the token appears. Times recorded as <now> are any time the Executor gave during the case; seeded times (2024-01-01) must come back unchanged. Versions Core makes are named <version:n> in the expected rows: any ver-<uuid> id.

add/duplicate-name.why: Names are compared trimmed, NFC-normalised and fully Unicode case-folded within the project: " ärger db " is "Ärger DB" (c1).

add/duplicate-name-full-case-folding.why: Full Unicode case folding: "STRASSE" is c1's "Straße".

add/empty-name.why: A name must be non-empty after trimming.

add/keychain-failure.why: Secrets are written first: a failed keychain set refuses the call and nothing is stored. Today the row is saved and a warning toast says the password wasn't.

add/missing-project.why: A missing parent is refused by name before anything is written; today the insert fails on the foreign key with SQLite's text.

add/nul-in-name.why: No string may hold a NUL. (sql.js stored the name cut at the NUL, "a".)

add/port-fraction.why: The port must be a whole number from 0 to 65535.

add/port-out-of-range.why: The port must be a whole number from 0 to 65535.

add/unknown-label-id.why: Label ids must be the predefined three or the project's own; today "label-nope" is stored.

import/name-taken.why: Import drafts carry renameIfTaken: Core stores the first free name, "Local (2)", inside the transaction. Today the import keeps "Local" next to c1's "Local".

import/name-taken-case-only.why: renameIfTaken compares with name_key, so "local" clashes with c1's "Local" and is stored as "local (2)". Today both stay.

import/shared-project-name-case-only.why: projectCreate with renameIfTaken compares folded names: "main" clashes with p1's "Main" and the project is "main (2)". Today the exact-match de-duplication keeps "main".

import/two-drafts-same-name.why: The second draft of one import named "Shop" finds the first one taken and is stored as "Shop (2)". Today both are "Shop".

label/create.why: Each label call writes one project_labels row (and labelRemove the connection_labels it strips); the project row, and so its updated_at, is left alone. Today the whole project is saved with updated_at now.

label/create-bad-colour.why: A label colour is #rrggbb (the plan's LabelDraft); today "red" is stored.

label/create-duplicate-name.why: Custom label names are unique within a project after case-folding: "team" is label-a's "Team".

label/remove-in-use.why: Each label call writes only project_labels and the connection_labels it strips, so the project's updated_at stays (today the whole project is saved with updated_at now). labelRemove strips the label id from every connection, so no row points at a missing label: c3, in p2, loses p1's label-a too (today only p1's connections are stripped).

label/remove-unknown.why: Today the project row is saved again (its updated_at moves) and nothing else happens.

label/rename-and-recolour.why: Each label call writes one project_labels row (and labelRemove the connection_labels it strips); the project row, and so its updated_at, is left alone. Today the whole project is saved with updated_at now.

labels/other-projects-label.why: Another project's label is refused; today addLabelToConnection returns without saving or saying anything.

labels/set-with-unknown-id.why: An unknown label id is refused; today setConnectionLabels drops it and saves the rest.

project/add-duplicate-name.why: "  MAIN " is "Main" (p1) after trimming and case-folding.

project/add-empty-name.why: A name must be non-empty after trimming.

project/remove-beta-era.why: On a file that started on v2026.4.5-beta.1, saved_queries and dashboards have no foreign key to the project; projectRemove deletes them by project_id in the same transaction. Today q2 (with its version v1) and d2 outlive the project.

project/remove-last.why: The last project is refused by Core; today ProjectManager.remove returns false with nothing stored.

project/remove-unknown-id.why: Today the deletes find nothing and remove returns true.

project/update-unknown-id.why: Today persistProjects finds no such project in memory and saves nothing, silently.

remove/unknown-id.why: A missing row is refused; today the delete finds nothing and succeeds.

saved-query/create-duplicate-name.why: Saved query names are unique within a project and folder after case-folding: "ORDERS" is q1's "Orders" (both in no folder).

saved-query/create-empty-name.why: A name must be non-empty after trimming.

saved-query/create-then-update-within-50.why: Create then update: the update appends version 1, a keyframe of "SELECT 1", after the row exists. Today the version is inserted before the 500 ms save writes the row, fails on the foreign key and is only logged.

saved-query/delete-unknown.why: Today the list is saved unchanged.

saved-query/eleven-versions.why: Every version is a keyframe holding the previous text whole (Q10). Today version 11 is a keyframe and 2–10 are diff-match-patch diffs.

saved-query/null-and-empty-folder-are-on.why: A NULL folder and "" are the same folder, so q2 (folder "") renamed "Orders" clashes with q1 (no folder).

saved-query/prune-at-0.why: query_version_limit 0 keeps every version. Today only version 1 is stored: the in-memory prune drops every version at 0, so the next number is 1 again and the insert fails on the unique constraint (logged only; a bug, see the README).

saved-query/prune-at-3.why: Keyframes, pruned to the newest 3 (all keyframes, so exactly 3). Today the recorded fifth version is a diff taken against the text the in-memory list resolves to after a prune, and the stored history resolves version 5 to "SELECT 4SELECT 3" (a bug, see the README).

saved-query/prune-keeps-back-to-keyframe.why: Pruning to 3 keeps back to the nearest keyframe: v2 and v3 are diffs on v1, so v1 stays, and the new versions are keyframes. Today v1 is deleted, v2 is rewritten as a keyframe, and version 5 is a diff that resolves to "SELECT SELECT e" (the prune bug, see the README).

saved-query/rename-to-taken-name.why: "orders" is q1's "Orders" in the same (no) folder.

saved-query/two-tabs-both-create.why: Each create is its own write; nothing replaces the project's list, so both windows' queries stay. Today the second window's replace-all save deletes the first one's query (the loss Task 1's stopgap leaves when both windows edit).

saved-query/update-name-only.why: An unchanged text adds no version (Q10). Today every save of a linked query adds one.

saved-query/update-parameters.why: Only the parameters change, so no version is added (Q10). Today each save adds one.

saved-query/versions-after-existing.why: The new version 4 is a keyframe of the previous text ("SELECT d"); the stored diffs stay as they are.

update/ai-flags-left-out.why: A patch that leaves the AI flags out keeps them. Today update() copies them from its input, which has none, so they are cleared.

update/port-out-of-range.why: The port must be a whole number from 0 to 65535.
